name: Intrepid descent stage
note: origin. lat -3.0128 lon 336.5781. Surface radius 1735977.76 m (-1422.2 m vs 1737.4 km sphere)

name: Surveyor 3
note: on the inner slope of Surveyor crater. lat -3.0162 lon 336.5820

name: Surveyor 3 retrorocket impact
note: bonus. Surveyor's spent solid rocket hit here on 20 Apr 1967

name: ALSEP central station
note: 126 m from the lander at bearing 316 (north-west). lat -3.0098 lon 336.5752

name: Passive seismometer
note: 2.8 m ESE of central station. LROC table rounds it to 3 m SW; report says 10 ft east. Use the map.

name: SNAP-27 generator
note: 3.4 m WNW of central station. Report: 10 ft cable west.

name: Solar wind spectrometer
note: 4.7 m south of central station. Report: 13 ft south.

name: Magnetometer
note: 16 m SSE of central station. Report: 50 ft cable SE.

name: Ion detector (SIDE) and cold cathode gauge
source: McInall map + PSR p.85 + Mission Report fig 3-6
note: 18 m WSW of central station. PSR: about 50 ft SW. Report: 60 ft cable. Gauge 3-5 ft from SIDE.

name: US flag
note: journal says about 7 m out from the equipment bay between west and north legs. Map puts it about 15 m NNW of the lander centre.

name: S-band dish antenna (fallen)
note: drawn upright on the map. Blown over by the liftoff thruster test. Journal: about 6 m north of north footpad.

name: TV camera final spot
note: end of the TV cable. 19 m NNE of the lander. CONFLICTS with object sheet (6 m SW). CAM 1 depends on this.

name: Solar wind collector
note: foil went home. Whether the staff was left is unsourced.
